ingredients.title: What you are actually smelling.
ingredients.intro: Every HASERA blend is built from materials we can name. These are the key ingredients across the collection.

items.name: Bergamot
items.text: Italian citrus that carries the freshness of the first spray.

items.name: Blackcurrant
items.text: A dark berry that keeps the opening sharp and modern.

items.name: Lychee
items.text: Sweet and juicy, a light and welcoming top note.

items.name: Plum
items.text: Ripe fruit that brings warm sweetness from the start.

items.name: Rhubarb
items.text: Slightly tart and green, the counterweight to sweetness.

items.name: Rose
items.text: The classic floral heart that never dates.

items.name: Peony
items.text: A soft floral that keeps the rose feeling fresh.

items.name: Lavender
items.text: A calming herb that adds a clean, grown-up edge.

items.name: Orange blossom
items.text: Softly sweet citrus flower bridging fresh and warm.

items.name: Honey
items.text: Natural sweetness that clings and reads as luxurious.

items.name: Hazelnut
items.text: A gourmand touch that makes the scent warm and comfortable.

items.name: Warm spice
items.text: A little heat to stop the sweetness going too far.

items.name: Vanilla
items.text: The soft sweet base that lasts longest on skin.

items.name: Amber
items.text: Warm resin that adds depth and staying power.

items.name: Musk
items.text: A clean skin-like note that makes a perfume feel part of you.

items.name: White musk
items.text: A lighter, cleaner musk for the floral blends.

items.name: Cedarwood
items.text: Dry wood that gives structure and a firm edge.

items.name: Cashmere wood
items.text: Soft wood that leaves a smooth dry-down.

items.q: Are HASERA perfumes original and authentic?
items.a: Yes, HASERA perfumes are original. Every bottle is blended and sealed by HASERA in Indonesia rather than resold from third-party stock. Because we blend in-house, we can account for exactly what is in the bottle that reaches you.

items.q: How long does HASERA perfume last?
items.a: HASERA perfume lasts 6-8 hours on skin, depending on your skin type and activity. On fabric it can hold up to 12 hours, because cloth fibres release fragrance more slowly than skin does. Dry skin typically holds scent for less time than oily skin.

items.q: Where can I buy HASERA perfume?
items.a: HASERA perfume is sold through three official channels: direct message on WhatsApp, our official Shopee store, and our official TikTok Shop store. We do not sell through resellers, so buy from one of those three to be sure of what you receive.

HASERA ships across Indonesia through Shopee and TikTok Shop courier partners. Delivery estimates, shipping costs and tracking numbers follow whichever marketplace you ordered from, so the parcel can be tracked directly in that app.

Yes, every HASERA fragrance is cruelty-free. We do not test on animals, and our raw materials are ethically sourced from suppliers held to the same standard. This applies across the whole collection, not just selected scents.

tentang-kami.metaTitle: About HASERA: An Indonesian Perfume Brand
tentang-kami.metaDescription: HASERA is an Indonesian perfume brand. We blend and seal every bottle ourselves, and we do not resell third-party stock.
tentang-kami.title: Made by us, not resold.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: HASERA is an Indonesian perfume brand. We make fragrance for people who treat scent as part of their identity rather than an accessory. It is the thing people remember about you after you have left the room.
We currently make three signature fragrances: Cleopatra Noir, Georgia Flora and Croesus Gold. Each has its own character and story rather than being a variation on one base.

sections.heading: How we work
body: Every HASERA bottle is blended and sealed by us. We are not a reseller and we do not sell on third-party stock, which means we know exactly what is in the bottle you receive.
We list the materials we use openly on the collection page and on every product page. You should know what you are putting on your skin every day.
All HASERA fragrances are cruelty-free and ethically sourced.

sections.heading: Why the price is what it is
body: We sell directly to you through WhatsApp, Shopee and TikTok Shop. No physical store, no distributor, no chain of middlemen adding margin at every step.
We think good perfume should not be something you save for special occasions. A fair price means you can wear it every day.

sections.heading: Get in touch
body: WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us. We are also on Instagram and TikTok, and our official stores are on Shopee and TikTok Shop.
If you are not sure which scent suits you, just ask. We would rather you buy the right one than buy quickly and regret it.

kebijakan-privasi.metaDescription: How HASERA collects, uses and protects your data when you visit haseraperfume.com.
kebijakan-privasi.title: What we collect, and why.

sections.heading: The short version
body: We do not ask you to create an account, and there is no signup form on this site. We do not sell your data to anyone.
This site collects visit statistics through Google Analytics, plus anything you send us yourself when you get in touch over WhatsApp.

sections.heading: Google Analytics
body: We use Google Analytics 4 to understand which pages get opened and which buttons get clicked. This is collected in aggregate and we do not use it to identify you personally.
Google Analytics stores a cookie in your browser. You can delete or block it in your browser settings, or use the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. The site works normally without it.

sections.heading: When you contact us
body: If you message us on WhatsApp we receive your number and the contents of your message. We use it only to answer your question and process your order.
WhatsApp conversations are also governed by WhatsApp's own privacy policy, not just ours.

sections.heading: Third-party services
body: The buy buttons on this site send you to Shopee and TikTok Shop. Once you move there your data is governed by each platform's privacy policy, including payment and delivery details. We never receive your payment details.
This site is hosted by Vercel, which keeps standard access logs for operational and security purposes.

sections.heading: Your rights and how to reach us
body: You can ask for access to the data we hold about you, ask for corrections, or ask us to delete it. Message us on WhatsApp and we will handle it.
We may update this policy from time to time. Changes take effect once published on this page.

pengiriman-pengembalian.metaDescription: How to order HASERA perfume, delivery across Indonesia, and what to do if an item arrives damaged or incorrect.
pengiriman-pengembalian.title: Ordering, delivery, and when something goes wrong.

sections.heading: How to order
body: Three ways: message us directly on WhatsApp, or shop at our official stores on Shopee and TikTok Shop.
If you want help choosing a scent, WhatsApp is fastest. If you want buyer protection and a full range of payment methods, Shopee or TikTok Shop is more convenient.

sections.heading: Delivery
body: We ship across Indonesia through Shopee and TikTok Shop courier partners.
Delivery estimates, shipping costs and tracking numbers follow the marketplace you ordered from. Once dispatched you can track the parcel directly in the Shopee or TikTok Shop app.
Every bottle ships sealed. If the seal is broken when the parcel reaches you, do not use it. Photograph it and contact us straight away.

sections.heading: Damaged or incorrect items
body: If what you receive is damaged, leaking, or not what you ordered, contact us within 48 hours of delivery.
Include an uncut unboxing video if you have one, or at minimum photos of the parcel, the seal and the bottle. This is the same standard the marketplaces use and it speeds things up considerably.
For orders placed on Shopee or TikTok Shop, file the return through their app so the process stays protected by their system. We will help push it through from our side.

sections.heading: Changed your mind
body: Because perfume goes directly onto skin, we cannot accept back a bottle whose seal has been opened simply because the scent was not to your taste.
Ask before you buy. Tell us on WhatsApp what you normally like and we will point you at the closest match.

cleopatra-noir.metaDescription: A HASERA signature fragrance of lavender, orange blossom and vanilla. Lasts 6-8 hours on skin, 50 ml. Ships across Indonesia.
cleopatra-noir.tagline: Bold up front. Soft in the middle. Deep at the end.
story: Cleopatra did not conquer with a sword. She conquered with presence: the way she entered a room, the way she spoke quietly and everyone stopped, the way people forgot what they had meant to say.

Cleopatra Noir opens sharp and fresh with bergamot and blackcurrant. Minutes later lavender and orange blossom move in, bringing a softness you would not expect from something this strong. What stays at the end of the day is vanilla, musk and cedarwood, all warm, close, and lasting.
The contrast is deliberate. Sharp at the start, soft in the middle, deep at the close, exactly like someone you cannot read in the first five minutes, and remember precisely because of it.
Wear it on the days you do not intend to be forgotten.

faq.a: Cleopatra Noir suits anyone who likes a warm, sweet scent with real character. It reads feminine without being overly sweet, so it works day to day as well as for evenings out. Best for people who want to be remembered rather than merely noticed.

faq.q: When is Cleopatra Noir best worn?
faq.a: Cleopatra Noir peaks in the late afternoon and evening: dinners, special occasions, dates. Its lavender and vanilla read warmer as the temperature drops. For daytime, one or two sprays is enough to keep it from feeling heavy.

faq.q: How long does Cleopatra Noir last on skin?
faq.a: Cleopatra Noir lasts 6-8 hours on skin, depending on skin type and activity. On fabric it can hold up to 12 hours. Its vanilla, musk and cedarwood base is the part that lingers longest.

faq.q: How is Cleopatra Noir different from Georgia Flora?
faq.a: Cleopatra Noir is warmer and more oriental, led by lavender and vanilla, while Georgia Flora is fresher and more floral, led by rose and fruit. Cleopatra Noir reads bold and suits evenings; Georgia Flora reads graceful and suits daytime.

faq.q: Does Cleopatra Noir work in hot weather?
faq.a: Cleopatra Noir works in Indonesian heat as long as you go lightly. High temperatures open sweet notes faster and push them further, so two sprays is more than enough. Apply to pulse points rather than clothing so it does not build up.

georgia-flora.metaTitle: Georgia Flora: Rose Floral Perfume for Women
georgia-flora.metaDescription: A HASERA signature fragrance of rose, lychee and peony over a soft musk base. Lasts 6-8 hours on skin, 50 ml. Ships across Indonesia.
story: Some people look elegant because they work at it. Others are elegant simply in how they walk, sit, and answer a question. Georgia is the second kind.

Georgia Flora opens with lychee and rhubarb that are sweet, faintly tart, and fresh as early morning air. Then rose and peony take over, and at that point it is unmistakable: this is a floral, without hesitation. Underneath, white musk and cashmere wood leave a clean trail that holds into the evening.
This is not a scent that shouts. It is the one that makes people lean half a step closer without knowing why, and then ask what you are wearing.
For workdays, for weddings, for ordinary days you would like to feel less ordinary.

faq.a: Georgia Flora suits anyone who likes fresh florals that are not too heavy. It is an easy scent for daily wear, especially if you are still working out which fragrance family you prefer.

faq.q: When is Georgia Flora best worn?
faq.a: Georgia Flora is best worn in the morning and through the day: the office, campus, outdoor events. Its lychee and rose read freshest while the air is still light. It still works at night for a softer impression.

Georgia Flora is not overly sweet. The sweetness comes from lychee in the opening, then rose and white musk balance it in the heart. The result reads clean and fresh rather than sugary, so it is safe for enclosed rooms.

faq.q: How long does Georgia Flora last on skin?
faq.a: Georgia Flora lasts 6-8 hours on skin and up to 12 hours on fabric. Spray on pulse points such as wrists and neck to get the most from it. Do not rub after spraying, as rubbing makes the scent fade faster.

faq.q: Is Georgia Flora a good gift?
faq.a: Georgia Flora is the safest gift choice in the HASERA collection. Florals appeal broadly and do not demand a specific taste, so there is little risk if you do not know the recipient's fragrance preferences.

croesus-gold.metaTitle: Croesus Gold: Sweet Amber Woody Perfume
croesus-gold.metaDescription: A HASERA signature fragrance of plum, honey and amber woods. Sweet, warm, lasts 6-8 hours on skin. 50 ml, ships across Indonesia.
croesus-gold.tagline: Winning does not need to shout.
story: In the ancient world one name became the measure of wealth: Croesus. People did not say "as rich as a king". They said "as rich as Croesus". The name stopped being a name and became a standard.

Croesus Gold is built for people who understand that winning is not about who speaks loudest. It opens sweet and immediate: plum and bergamot. But what remains hours later is amber, cedarwood and vanilla, all warm, deep, and unhurried.
This is a scent that works in a crowded room. Not the one demanding attention, but the one people still remember after everyone has gone home.

Wear it when you need to be the most certain version of yourself. The interview, the pitch, the night that decides something. Croesus Gold does not turn you into someone else. It sharpens who you already are.

faq.q: Is Croesus Gold for men or women?
faq.a: Croesus Gold is a unisex fragrance, though its sweet-warm character over amber and cedarwood means men choose it most often. Women who enjoy gourmand scents wear it just as well, since its sweetness leans warm rather than floral.

faq.q: When is Croesus Gold best worn?
faq.a: Croesus Gold is strongest at night and for occasions that matter, such as a pitch or an interview. Its amber and cedarwood base reads deeper as the temperature drops. In hot daytime weather, drop to one or two sprays.

Croesus Gold is a strong fragrance and is easily noticed by people nearby. It projects further than the other two HASERA scents. If you prefer something soft that stays close to the skin, Georgia Flora is the better fit.

faq.q: How long does Croesus Gold last on skin?
faq.a: Croesus Gold lasts 6-8 hours on skin and up to 12 hours on fabric. Its amber and cedarwood base gives it the longest dry-down in the HASERA collection. That is also what makes it feel strongest in the first few hours.

faq.q: Can I wear Croesus Gold to the office?
faq.a: Croesus Gold can be worn to the office with a lighter hand. One spray is enough in an air-conditioned room so it does not overwhelm the people around you. In an open-plan or crowded office, Georgia Flora is the safer choice.
